top_findings.title: GET /books/{id} returns 500 instead of 404 for a missing book
top_findings.evidence: src/repository.rs:66-74 get_book_by_id uses .fetch_one(); a missing row yields sqlx::Error::RowNotFound, propagated by `?` through AppError::Database(#[from] sqlx::Error) (src/lib.rs:8-9) and mapped to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR (src/lib.rs:18-19). Route exists and returns a single book for existing ids (src/api.rs:26-33), but the pinned R4 requires 404 if absent. Contrast delete_book (src/repository.rs:99-108) which checks rows_affected and returns AppError::NotFound.
top_findings.suggestion: In get_book_by_id, map sqlx::Error::RowNotFound to AppError::NotFound (e.g. .fetch_optional() then ok_or(AppError::NotFound)), so a missing id yields 404.
